tool.title: Query the beans knowledge graph
tool.description: Query the beans knowledge graph using named graph analytics or arbitrary SPARQL 1.1.

inputs.name: sparql
inputs.description: Arbitrary SPARQL 1.1 SELECT query over the bean store.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Output format: table, json, or ids.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Query results formatted as a table, JSON or IDs, for people to read.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The rows as one `BeanQueryRows` record, each variable to its value with bean IRIs shortened to ids: `structuredContent.rows` over MCP in every format, and the text itself with format json. Programs and BPMN gateways read this; people read `report`.
